Interpret each interaction in the context of the complete email. Do not infer that a request has been followed or that an action has succeeded.

A request for such a decision is sufficient textual evidence without proof of a completed decision. Merely reading content, acknowledging receipt, or confirming factual details does not by itself establish evaluation or decision-making.
